sources.entry: Dawarich - Visualize your location history, track your movements, and analyze your travel patterns with complete privacy and control (alternative to Google Timeline a.k.a. Google Location History). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Dawarich | Location history tracker, a Google Timeline alternative

summary.one_liner: Dawarich is a self-hostable web app that records and visualizes location history as an alternative to Google Timeline.
summary.what_it_does:
Dawarich ingests location data from tracking apps (such as OwnTracks, Overland, GPSLogger, PhoneTrack and Home Assistant) and from file imports including Google Maps Timeline, GPX, GeoJSON, OwnTracks and Strava. It displays history on an interactive map with selectable layers: heatmap, points, lines between points and fog of war. It supports trips with route, distance and time details, plus places with visit radii and visit suggestions (beta). Statistics cover countries and cities visited, distance traveled and time spent by year and month, along with a days-per-country view. Immich and Photoprism credentials can be supplied to pull in geotagged photos. Data can be exported as GeoJSON or GPX.</what_it_does>

use_cases: Self-host a replacement for Google Timeline
Track personal travel and movements over time
Import Google Takeout or GPX history into one place
Review trips, countries and cities visited for tax or travel records
Share live location with family members
Map geotagged photos from Immich or Photoprism
how_to_run: Open the app in your browser at the address shown in the README (URL truncated in the source).
Optionally create a .env file based on .env.example to customize settings.
Log in with the default demo credentials and change them in account settings.
To stop the app, press Ctrl+C.
stack: Ruby on Rails (implied by project context, not named in README)
notable: Covers both live tracking from mobile apps and bulk import of historical location data
Fog of War and heatmap map layers
Days-in-country view useful for tax residency
Optional Immich and Photoprism integration for photo geodata
Companion iOS and Android apps listed by the project
caveats: Under active development; the README warns of frequent updates, bugs and breaking changes
README advises against automatic updates and recommends backing up before upgrading
Default demo credentials must be changed after first run
